Product DescriptionThe FSP ZEN400 fanless 400 watt power supply gives you total silence, SLI and Crossfire compatibility, and an 80 PLUS Bronze efficiency rating all in one package. An extremely efficient heat sink on the ZEN400 enables the power supply to operate under load without cooling fans. No need to worry about connectors either because this fanless power supply has 4 molex, 2 sata and 2 pci express connectors to fit just about any application. Enjoy dual 12 volt rails that can distribute a total of 27 amps while operating at 0db.
